_note: v2 dual-unit wardrobe, LOCKED Sep 27 2026 (Beth: 'Adopt all — restructure the wardrobe'). Every garment is both a ritual component (equippable per-part in the chapter dressing ritual) and an ensemble member (tracked in the Atelier Album). 50 ensembles (10 per Group 1 collection: 4 Atelier / 3 Couture / 2 Imperiale / 1 Legende). The Triumph Gown is TIME-ONLY (never purchasable). Scoring weights hidden — only the +3% Harmony bonus is a number. Currencies: Crowns (premium), coins (soft).

gazette_rubric: fabric coherence (intentional contrast praised; incoherent clashing critiqued, never harshly)

documented_system_rules: Closet collections: 30+ themed collections, surfaced in groups of 5; 10 cards per collection (4 Common, 3 Fine, 2 Rare, 1 Ultra-Rare). Completing a collection adds its garments to the permanent closet; duplicates feed the Modiste's Exchange.
Card draws: five favors draw one random card; favors are earned, never bought.

Jewel shelf: per level ~3 dresses + 1-2 tiaras; two pools never mixed — card-pool ultra-rares (velocity, not exclusivity; same item earnable through favor draws) and challenge-exclusives (unique to that level's challenge, never in cards, owned forever, wearable in future chapters). No shelf item gates a story outcome.
No avatar unlocks — rewards are outfits, hair, accessories only.
Every premium outfit needs a credible free path (long but real). Time-only items exist (never purchasable at any price).

Dual-unit wardrobe (LOCKED Sep 27 2026): every garment is simultaneously a ritual component (bodice/sleeves/skirt/etc., each with fabric + color choices in the dressing ritual) and a member of a named ensemble. Completion % is tracked per ensemble in the Atelier Album.
Ensembles carry a fictional modiste voice; every component carries 1-2 lines of lore, written so an ensemble's lore reads as a micro-story. Collecting all of an ensemble's lore awards a codex entry.

Colorway matrix (LOCKED): every design ships base + named recolor + dye-unlockable palette. Palettes unlock per ensemble, never per piece. Duplicates feed the dye/evolution system — no draw is ever dead.
Portrait Moment: assembling a full ensemble in canonical configuration unlocks a Regency portrait illustration (also the competition entry's display frame). Non-stat — never distorts voting fairness.
Harmony bonus (LOCKED): +3% presentation in Daily Vote for 3+ pieces of one ensemble, clearly labeled on the entry. Never tied to acquisition recency or spend.

Saison drops: collections release as limited-time Saisons with cinematic reveals for top rarity. Vault policy (published): ensembles return through events, never through crafting; 'never again' exclusives are never re-sold.
Rarity tiers are named Atelier / Couture / Imperiale / Legende (were Common / Fine / Rare / Ultra-Rare), each with distinct reveal cinematics. The Timeless tag exempts pieces from seasonal churn.
Merge chains terminate in named signature ensemble components (see merge_chain_signatures) — the merge board feeds the wardrobe directly.

ensembles.name: Muslin Morning Gown

modiste.name: Élise Marchand
modiste.voice: Warm, precise, conspiratorial — fashion as intelligence. Speaks to Rose as a co-conspirator: what the gown must do, not only how it looks.

ensembles.story: The armor of respectability, cut so plainly it disarms. Elise's first lesson to Rose: the ton notices what you withhold, and a plain gown makes them lean closer.

components.name: White Muslin Bodice
components.lore: Cut high and plain, because the morning call is a negotiation and the bodice must give nothing away.

components.name: Long Muslin Sleeves
components.lore: Long to the wrist. Idle hands are watched; covered hands are merely elegant.

components.name: White Muslin Skirt
components.lore: A round gown with no train to trip on and no flounce to apologize for.

components.name: Cambric Chemisette
components.lore: The chemisette is the lie politely told: modesty, worn where modesty is graded.

components.name: Plain Sash
components.lore: One sash, tied once. Restraint is a kind of ornament, if you commit to it.

components.name: Soft Morning Slippers
components.lore: Slippers, because the morning room is a home battlefield and one should move quietly.

ensembles.portrait_moment: Rose at the morning-room window, muslin luminous in daylight, the ton's gaze held politely at a distance.

components.name: Sprigged Muslin Skirt

components.name: Straw Bonnet

components.name: Kid Gloves

components.name: Walking Slippers

components.name: Half-Boots

components.name: House Slippers

components.name: Basted Silk Bodice
components.lore: Seams basted, not sewn: the bodice admits it is becoming. Honesty, tailored.

components.name: Unfinished Sleeves

components.name: Basted Silk Skirt
components.lore: The skirt hangs on basting thread and intention.

components.name: Chalk Marks in Elise's Hand
components.lore: Chalk lines where the gown will go. Elise's handwriting, worn as ornament.

components.name: Pinned Chemisette

components.name: Pin-Cushion Chatelaine

components.name: Fitting Slippers

components.name: Workroom Coiffure

components.name: Wicker Basket

components.name: Garden Gloves

components.name: Pearl-Grey Gloves

components.name: Silk Slippers

components.name: Beaded Reticule

Opera gown: the season's first real statement.

Ball gown final fitting: the season's first full statement.

Undressing: the gown put away, the night inventoried.
Sitting dress: chosen for stillness, for the artist's eye (Octavia).
Tea gown: armor disguised as prettiness; simple dark green because Octavia said 'You look like yourself.'

story_wardrobe_references.description: Country dress: plain, private, no performance.
Country gown: simple, deliberate.
Drive dress: visible, correct.

Black silk domino; Julian's black silk mask token.
The domino worn; Julian's confession in the dark walks.

story_wardrobe_references.chapter: S1 L21 — A Voice Below Stairs
story_wardrobe_references.description: Plain dress: below stairs, no performance.

story_wardrobe_references.description: War gown: every inch a statement.

story_wardrobe_references.chapter: S1 L24 — The Promenade, Terms Stated
story_wardrobe_references.description: Stated-terms gown: no ambiguity, in dress or intent; the emerald, the good gloves, for the possibility of Henry.
Refuge dress: soft, private, unarmored.
Chambers dress: serious, plain, believed.
Trap gown: beautiful, deliberate, bait; Henry deploys his full-dress uniform, Bath star, spent on her in public.
Élise's masterpiece; message: Triumph / Mourning-for-the-war / Joy; tokens: Julian's white rose, Laurent's ribbon (worn under the glove), Henry's book of hours, Octavia's sketch of Rose laughing.
Family gown: loved, familiar, true.
The triumph gown worn; the triumph bouquet, from whom the player's choice.
Bath plain-clothes designed to be underestimated; gown remade from old Hartwell silk at the ball paying Drummond's first installment; dresses to be seen winning at the Bath assembly.
Unimpeachable: every gown a verdict; ink under her fingernails at the ball where the libel breaks; white roses at the vindication.
Black-and-gold masquerade (black and gold, mask removed for the confrontation); severe solvent propriety; Hartwell colors restored as a flag at the Assembly.
Dressing as power; Élise's assembly gown (severe, magnificent, unmistakable); a single bloom of the player's choice.
Restraint-as-display for the City; muddy hems of the canal expedition; ball gown the Park's own money paid for.
Hartwell heirlooms — old lace, grandmother's jewels, remade stored silks; de Valcourt colors beside Hartwell colors at the ball; white and simple for the reclamation ceremony.
Armor: the fête gown, the most magnificent of the series, Hartwell colors; red roses with the thorns left on.
Severe propriety; grandmother's pearls at the hearing; the verdict gown — quiet, absolute.
The housewarming gown, Élise's finest; the farewell masquerade quotes the S1 triumph gown; the final assembly: dressed as herself — no armor, no statement, no performance.
